scenarios.title: Fake tuition invoice
scenarios.goal: A message that impersonates the university's bursary office with a different account.

steps.label: Student asks the agent to check the message

payload.text:
URGENT - Pearl River University (Shenzhen) Bursary Office
Dear student, pay your Spring 2027 tuition today only and get a 15% discount.
Amount: CNY 22,100. Pay by WeChat transfer to our agent.
Account number: 6222 9911 0042 7788
Do not contact the university office, this offer is confidential.

red_flags.explanation: Offers a discount on fees (universities do not sell discounts through agents)
Asks for crypto, gift cards or a transfer to a personal account / e-wallet
Asks you to keep it secret or not contact the university
The name matches Pearl River University (Shenzhen), but this account is NOT its official account.

payee_verification.message: The name matches Pearl River University (Shenzhen), but this account is NOT its official account.

second_opinion.explanation: Legitimate universities never ask for tuition payments via personal WeChat transfers or private agents. The request to keep the payment confidential and avoid contacting the university is a classic tactic to prevent you from verifying the scam.
red_flags: Request to pay via personal WeChat transfer
Demand for secrecy from the university office
second_opinion.advice: Do not send any money; log in to your official university student portal to check your balance and pay only through the university's verified payment channels.
